templates.prompt: Create a premium minimalist logo for a modern brand. Use a simple memorable symbol, clean geometric shapes, balanced proportions, and professional typography. Keep the design flat, scalable, elegant, and recognizable at small sizes. Use a refined color palette with strong contrast and a clean white or transparent background.

templates.prompt: Design a futuristic professional logo for a technology startup. Create an original abstract symbol inspired by innovation, connectivity, intelligence, and digital technology. Use sharp but balanced geometry, modern typography, and a sophisticated tech color palette. The logo should look premium, trustworthy, scalable, and suitable for an app icon, website, and business cards.

templates.title: Luxury Brand Logo
templates.subtitle: Elegant identity with a premium feel
templates.prompt: Create an elegant luxury brand logo with a sophisticated emblem and refined typography. Use balanced symmetry, subtle geometric details, generous spacing, and a timeless visual style. The design should communicate exclusivity, quality, confidence, and premium craftsmanship. Keep it minimal and suitable for packaging, storefronts, websites, and social media.

templates.title: Restaurant Logo
templates.subtitle: Distinctive branding for food businesses
templates.prompt: Design a memorable logo for a modern restaurant or food brand. Create a distinctive symbol related to food, cooking, hospitality, or the restaurant concept without using generic clip-art. Combine the symbol with bold, readable typography and a warm professional color palette. Make the identity versatile for menus, packaging, signage, delivery apps, and social media.

templates.title: Personal Brand Logo
templates.subtitle: Build a recognizable creator identity
templates.prompt: Create a distinctive personal brand logo for a creator, entrepreneur, consultant, or professional. Develop a memorable monogram or abstract symbol based on the brand identity, combined with clean modern typography. Keep the design confident, minimal, versatile, and highly recognizable. It should work perfectly as a profile picture, website logo, social media identity, and watermark.
